title: A value that outlives the process
summary: A theme in a cookie, a cache in redis, and one option saying so on each. Toggle it, then reload and watch which frame it comes back on.

bench.note: AUTHORED, not measured — nothing here runs until the compiler does. LINES OF CODE IS THE EXCEPTION: counted from the two arms in this download, code lines only, both arms complete — the theme on both sides, the flags cache, the keyed one, and the roster.

rows.metric: Frames painted before the stored value
Requests to the source, four instances restarting

tests.note: `bun test examples/persistence`. The order case is asserted on the PRODUCTIONS a reader saw, not on the settled value: a store read after the initial value settles on the same theme and paints the fallback first.

rows.name: a store answers before the initial value
a synchronous `get` paints no fallback frame and reports no pending
`refresh()` re-reads the store on a value with no body
a restored value passes `schema` and `transform` as a write does
a keyed memo derives one store per args key
a `set` that fails reaches `onError` and leaves the store attached
